taskPacket.objective: The judge of each node is the first eligible entry of an ordered judge list declared in the contract or the machine default, with a fallback of several hops and the choice recorded (second half of R18).
instructions: Read R18 in the spec. The canonical provider already exists: src/contract/provider.mjs canonicalProvider, and validateRuntime stamps it as the validated vendor (landed by canonical-provider).

The list: a contract field `judges` (ordered runtime ids, each declared in `runtimes`) and a machine default `judges` in the config `faberun setup` writes (src/host/config.mjs readUserConfig/writeUserConfig/isUserConfig; src/cli/setup.mjs). The contract list wins over the machine default, exactly as runtimeDefaults already wins over config (src/engine/runtime-discovery.mjs composeAssignments near :145-154). A node's explicit gate.runtime still wins over both. Validate the field in validateContract (src/contract/index.mjs, 763 lines: add it through a small helper module rather than grow the file past 800) and add it to the ValidatedContract typedef.

Choice per node: the first list entry whose canonical provider differs from the worker's (and from every provider the worker's fallback chain reaches), skipping an entry with a machine-recorded refusal (src/run/availability.mjs readRefusal, keyed by availabilityKey) or whose account usage window is above 90% (src/run/usage-windows.mjs readUsageWindows/usageAccountOf). Record the chosen judge and, for each skipped entry, why, in the node's routing evidence (state.routing; src/contract/snapshot.mjs validateRoutingState must accept the new field).

Multi-hop fallback: when the chosen judge is refused during the run, the next eligible entry takes over, as many times as the list allows, never returning to one already refused. Today failover is one hop by design (src/engine/backoff.mjs planRoute provider_failover_hop_cap, src/engine/failover.mjs nextSynthesizedRuntime); for the judge role with a list, the hop budget is the list length. src/engine/lifecycle.mjs is at 793 of 800 lines: move handleProviderExhaustion's judge branch into a new module before changing it.

Pin the test 'the judge is the first eligible entry of the list and falls back hop by hop' in the new file test/engine/judge-list.test.mjs: contract list over config list; skip by same provider, by recorded refusal and by a usage window above 90%; two refusals in a row move two hops; the evidence names every skip.
